# kion_idms_open_id (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion IdmsOpenId by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_idms_open_id" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the IdmsOpenId to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `authorization_endpoint` (String)
- `client_id` (String)
- `email_claim` (String)
- `first_name_claim` (String)
- `issuer` (String)
- `jwks_uri` (String)
- `last_name_claim` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `phone_claim` (String)
- `username_claim` (String)
